general_information.Syllabus Name: 3D Modeling & Texturing (Maya) Xây dựng mô hình và tạo chất liệu trong môi trường 3D
general_information.Description: This course will prepare you: This course covers the fundamentals of working in CG (Computer Graphic) with Maya. It’s only a starting point, though. As with any artistic pursuit, CG is a lifelong process of learning. With what you learn in this course forming a solid foundation, you can continue exploring all the complex, interesting facets of creating CG imagery Teaching methods: - Student is the center, practice combined with theory - Help students have a self-study method - Presentation method combined with group working method - Teachers are instructors, organizing activities - The result is a combination of teacher and student evaluation
general_information.StudentTasks: '<- Attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination < - Actively participate in class activities > < - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class > < - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose > < - Read the textbook in advance > < - Access the course website (www.cms.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment. >

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: LO_01: Students will be able to manipolate tools
LO_02: Students will be able to create some basic objects
LO_03: Students will be able to create some items: vase, bottle, cup, exhibition booth model..
LO_04: Students will be able to shape the hand and foot
LO_05: Students will be able to shape the head
LO_06: Students will be able to shape body
LO_07: Students will be able to assign material (part 01)
LO_08: Students will be able to assign material to the character ( part02)
LO_9: students will be able to apply lighting and render a model using Arnold Cinematic render a cartoon scene
LO_10: Students will be able to create a short clip introducing the characters using light, material and camera

assessments.Note: Student must deliver assignment in time.

schedule.Topic: 'Getting Started with Maya Working with basic tools
schedule.Student Materials: Textbooks, PPT presentation, and other resources
schedule.Student's Tasks: Student: Discussion. Teacher: 1 - Introduction to Autodesk Maya 2 - The Maya user interface 3 - Managing Scenes, Files, and Projects 4 - Creating primitive objects, moving, rotating, scaling object 5 - Shortcuts to manipulate the workspace, object 6 - Components and attributes 7- Select objects and components 8- Transform, group and parent objects 9- Snap and align objects 10- Operate keyboard shortcuts

schedule.Student Materials: Textbooks, workbooks, PPT presentation, and other resources
schedule.Student's Tasks: Student: Discussion, Exercises. Teacher: 1. CV Curve Tool Options 2. EP Curve Tool Options 3. Make a curve or surface open or closed 4. Create arcs 5. Reshape a curve or surface manually 6. Edit NURBS curves and surfaces

schedule.Student Materials: Textbooks, workbooks, PPT presentation, and other resources
schedule.Student's Tasks: Student: Discussion, Exercises. Teacher: 1- Revolve 2- Loft 3- Bevel 4- Boundary 5- Extrude 6- Put illustrator file into Maya

schedule.Student Materials: Textbooks, workbooks, PPT presentation, and other resources
schedule.Student's Tasks: Studnet: Discussion, Exercises. Teacher: 1. Analysis Grid (Grid runs rough blocks, the motion, the standard for animated mesh.) 2. Analyze how to implement Modeling (Modeling 1 block, Modeling partially combined, Retopolygy.) 3- Operate with select vertex, edge, face. 4- Work with Select menu: Similiar, Grow, Shrink. 5- Work with Edit Mesh menu: - Add Divisions - Bevel - Connect - Detach - Extrude - Duplicate - Chamfer

schedule.Student Materials: Textbooks, workbooks, PPT presentation, and other resources
schedule.Student's Tasks: Student: Discussion, Exercises. Teacher: 1- Faster operation with the same command on the command panel 2. Modeling with some command group - Mesh: combine, seprate ... - components: Extrude, Bridge, ... - Tool: Multicut, target weld, connect ... 3- Asymmetry of the face 4- Block out the eye 5- Block out the mouth and the chin 6- Build up the eye region 7. Some techniques for Modeling (Rounds, keeping the corner, smoothing the surface, connecting surfaces, the error checking, balance points, reverse normal ...)

schedule.Student Materials: Textbooks, workbooks, PPT presentation, and other resources
schedule.Student's Tasks: Student: Discussion, Exercises. Teacher: 1. Create the nose 2. Create the ear 3. Body topology 4. Adding the neck and the back of the head 5. Create the skin flow of the eyes 6. Connect the head to the body 7. Rediting the proportions 8. Reworking the topology 9. Use brush preset 10..Create custom brushes 11. Sculpt Tools 12. Paint in 3D objects

schedule.Student Materials: Textbooks, workbooks, PPT presentation, and other resources
schedule.Student's Tasks: Student: Discussion, Exercises. Teacher: Create and assign a material 1- Use hypershape 2- Apply materials 3- Work with material 4- Work with texture and position texture 5- Use displacement map

schedule.Student Materials: Textbooks, workbooks, PPT presentation, and other resources
schedule.Student's Tasks: Student: Discussion, Exercises. Teacher: 1- Mapping UVs 2- Planar UV mapping 3- Edit Uvs 4. Paint in 2D

schedule.Student Materials: Textbooks, workbooks, PPT presentation, and other resources
schedule.Student's Tasks: Student: Discussion, Exercises. Teacher: 1- Scene Setup 2- Working with camera 3- Light Settings 4- Shading

schedule.Student Materials: Textbooks, workbooks, PPT presentation, and other resources
schedule.Student's Tasks: Student: Discussion, Exercises. Teacher: 1- Rendering a scene 2- Lights, shadows, and cameras 3- Camera Depth of Field 4- Rendering
